tasks.short: Check property-transfer information and correct errors

steps.what: Read the actual property transfer documents and existing buyer, seller and sale-price records
Compare property identifiers, buyers, sellers and sales prices across the existing transfer records
Investigate flagged transfer differences against the instruments and resolve ambiguous buyers, sellers or consideration
Enter the supported corrections in the existing property information record and verify the changed fields
Save the corrected property information in the same working record

tasks.design: Match existing transfer fields with a deterministic comparison from the property records system {OTHER}. The appraiser resolves source differences and edits the existing working record using a source-linked correction form; ordinary persistence stays ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transfer instruments and working property records may have required repeated field-by-field visual comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Read-only exports, exact field comparisons and native correction forms can expose differences without deciding which legal party or sale amount is correct.
tasks.still_hard: Aliases, partial interests, combined transactions and non-market consideration need source interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser decides what the instrument supports and which correction is justified.

ambition.what: Correct the same transfer information with less repeated comparison and navigation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic comparisons can flag differences between existing property identifiers, parties and transaction amounts; ambiguous legal descriptions still require review.

assumptions: Boundary is checking and correcting the appraiser's existing internal property information, not amending a public title register or formally issuing an assessment. Any actual statutory amendment or external filing is a distinct gated action, not an ordinary save.

{OTHER} means the existing property appraisal/assessment records system. The transaction registry or conveyance producer supplies instrument ID, property ID, transfer date, buyer and seller names, sale amount, currency, interest transferred and original document reference. s1 counts current retrieval, reading and any source transcription; unavailable fields stay unresolved and are investigated in s3.

Test native matching and correction views first. s2 is only the manual cross-record comparison currently performed; pre-existing automatic matches have zero new labour benefit. Normalization can standardize spaces and formats but cannot merge uncertain identities or interpret consideration.

s4 retains 18 of its 24 units for actual source-supported edits and verification; the 6 removed units are repeated record navigation and re-entry of unchanged identifying fields. This is an unmeasured workflow estimate, not a customer baseline.

s3 retains all existing discrepancy investigation. New connector, failed-import and unmatched-format repair is explicitly budgeted as incremental upkeep. No source producer is asked to create an unpaid new dataset.

The working property record already exists and is used in subsequent valuation work. s5 is ordinary same-system persistence at the minimum schema share, fully retained, without self-approval or saving.
unknowns: Current source exports and identifier coverage
How much manual comparison survives native matching
Which corrections are ordinary working edits versus formal statutory actions
research_questions: Trace buyer, seller and price fields through several actual transfers, including a partial-interest sale.
Test missing documents, mismatched properties and failed imports without silently accepting a correction.

already_counted.description: Source reading, discrepancy resolution, supported edits and ordinary persistence remain in s1, s3, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and normalization rules and repair failed imports or unsupported source formats beyond case investigation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=15+0+30+18+1=64. Gross 36 minus 4 upkeep gives net 32. Conservative case: handwritten instruments and changed identifiers leave 24 of 30 comparison units manual; the correction form removes only 3 of 24 navigation units. Nine gross units less 4 upkeep gives 5; source interpretation and edits remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compile the existing sales prices, construction costs and rents for the defined property market and period
Assess source coverage and property comparability, resolving sales, cost and rent anomalies
Calculate and chart sales-price, construction-cost and rent movements for the checked comparable series
Interpret the trend evidence to assess property values or the accuracy of existing assessments in the actual workpaper
Save the trend workpaper in its existing valuation file

tasks.design: Import existing dated sales, cost and rent observations into a source-linked {SPREADSHEET}; fixed formulas and chart settings show movements only after the appraiser defines comparable series. The appraiser retains coverage checks, anomaly resolution and the valuation interpretation recorded in the existing {DOCS} workpaper.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing observations can require repeated table assembly and chart rebuilding across sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports, reproducible formulas and saved chart definitions can repeat these mechanical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Mix changes, thin markets, incentives and differences in construction specification can make apparent trends misleading.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser decides which observations are comparable and what a trend means for a particular valuation.

ambition.what: Revisit the specific comparable-series choice when a newly available sale materially changes the evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing tabular market observations can be imported and charted reproducibly, but comparability and valuation conclusions require appraisal judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes existing market-data assembly, analysis and the valuation workpaper actually used to support the assessment. Original property inspections, negotiations and final statutory assessment issuance are other tasks; no new report or distribution is invented.

The existing market-data providers supply transaction/property ID, observation date, location, property type, area and area basis, currency, sale amount or rent period, plus construction specification, cost date and index basis where relevant. s1 is today's manual copying of these available observations, not their original collection. Access/licensing and provider work are unchanged, not free new capture.

Missing or incompatible area, currency, period, cost specification or rent terms stop the affected comparison. s2 retains actual source checks, normalization judgement, manual exception transcription and comparable selection; incremental upkeep budgets connector failures beyond that case work.

Test native imports and saved charts first. Count only today's manual table assembly and chart setup; existing feeds, formula execution and chart rendering earn no labour saving. Proposed machine steps reproduce those removed manual operations and do not select comparables.

s4 retains interpretation, checking every plotted movement against sources and actual workpaper writing in full. The file is used for subsequent value justification. Ordinary same-system persistence is near zero, represented by the minimum share in s5, ungated and fully retained.
Shares are unmeasured design estimates. There is no new automated price recommendation or formal assessment commit.
unknowns: Actual manual assembly and chart preparation effort
Market observation rights and compatible metadata
Which source series are already imported natively
research_questions: Reproduce a real trend workpaper, including a change in the mix of properties sold.
Test inconsistent rent periods, missing floor areas and a revised cost series without producing a misleading comparable trend.

already_counted.description: Coverage, source anomalies, comparable selection and valuation workpaper interpretation remain in s2 and s4; ordinary persistence remains in s5.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings, formula definitions and chart bases and repair failed imports beyond retained case checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+14+1=55; gross 45 minus 4 upkeep gives net 41. Conservative case: inconsistent area and rent-period metadata leave 17 of 25 compilation units and 17 of 20 chart/calculation units manual. Eleven gross units less 5 upkeep for those sources gives 6. Comparable selection and interpretation stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect construction and improvements for valuation

steps.what: Retrieve the actual construction plans, previous property record and inspection scope
Inspect the new construction and major improvements, measuring and checking their actual condition and specification
Determine how the observed construction and improvements affect the property value
Write the actual construction inspection findings in the existing valuation workpaper
Save the construction inspection workpaper in the existing property file

tasks.design: Link the actual property plans in {OTHER} and reuse the existing inspection workpaper fields in {DOCS}. Site inspection, measurement, condition assessment and value judgement stay with the appraiser; the template only removes repeated reference navigation and identifying-field layout.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans and prior file references can require repeated navigation, while inspection notes repeat the same property identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing file links and document fields can reduce those small operations without interpreting the physical structure.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden defects, unfinished work, access limits and unusual construction require direct inspection and cautious valuation.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser notices discrepancies between the structure and the plans and explains their valuation significance.

ambition.what: The same physical inspection and reasoned findings remain the core work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked property references and document fields can reduce repeated navigation and identifying-field entry; they cannot replace a construction condition inspection.

assumptions: Boundary includes reference lookup, physical construction inspection, valuation judgement and the actual inspection workpaper used to support the valuation. No speculative follow-up report is added.

{OTHER} means the existing property records system and ordinary measurement equipment. The actual plan/property-file producer supplies property ID, plan revision, drawing date and floor/structure reference; s1 retains reading, verifying and retrieving missing plans. The appraiser produces observations and dimensions in s2 and their value interpretation in s3; those are not free structured inputs.

Test native links and the current workpaper template first. s1 removes 2 of 10 repeated navigation units and retains 8 source-reading units. s4 removes 1.8 of 9 units of repeated property headers and page layout; all observation capture, dimensions, explanation and checks retain 7.2 units. These are unmeasured estimates, not automatic reductions of the inspection.

The workpaper is an actual valuation support record. Ordinary same-system save is fully retained at the minimum share, ungated and earns no saving. No approval of the author's own internal note is introduced.

Failed references and unusual notes remain in s1/s4; upkeep adds only template/link maintenance and repairs beyond those retained case tasks. No new structured observation capture is priced as today's work.
unknowns: Whether the existing workpaper already fills identifiers
Which observations are recorded in the existing inspection practice
research_questions: Observe an inspection and identify which fields are actually written and later used in valuation.
Check the template against an altered plan revision and an incomplete or inaccessible structure.

already_counted.description: Reference checking, physical inspection, valuation judgement and substantive inspection writing remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain property links and inspection template fields, including broken-link repairs beyond normal case lookup.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=8+60+20+7.2+1=96.2. Gross 3.8 minus 1.5 upkeep gives net 2.3. Conservative case: altered plans require manual lookup retaining 9 of 10 units and a bespoke inspection note retains 8.5 of 9 writing units. The resulting 1.5 gross units just cover upkeep; physical inspection and value judgement are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check code and zoning effects on appraised property

steps.what: Retrieve the applicable building codes, zoning bylaws, mapped property designation and dated provisions
inputs: official dated code and zoning sources

steps.what: Check how the building codes and zoning bylaws apply to the actual property and affect its appraisal
inputs: existing property condition and use evidence

steps.what: Write the actual appraisal workpaper explanation of code and zoning effects with source references
Save the code and zoning workpaper in the existing appraisal file

tasks.design: Configure dated official-source links in {DOCS} to the relevant {GOV_PORTAL} code and zoning material. Reuse only source citation and property header fields in the actual appraisal workpaper; the appraiser retains applicability, uncertainty and valuation interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Official provisions and property designations may be spread over several dated pages and documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved source views and document reference fields can reduce repeated navigation and citation layout.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions, nonconforming use, amendments and enforcement uncertainty require contextual interpretation and sometimes specialist advice.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser identifies the limits of the evidence and explains their effect on value without presenting a search result as a compliance determination.

ambition.what: The same code and zoning appraisal check retains professional judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: dated source links and citation fields can shorten retrieval and workpaper preparation; they cannot establish legal applicability or a valuation effect.

assumptions: Boundary includes official-source lookup, property-specific appraisal interpretation and the actual supporting workpaper. It does not invent a compliance certificate, specialist opinion or additional report after a conversation.

The existing property file supplies identifier, address, use and relevant observation date. Official source publishers supply jurisdiction, designation, provision text, effective date, amendment reference and map version. s1 counts the appraiser's current navigation, reading and any manual citation capture; s2 counts applicability checks, gaps and existing property-evidence reading.

Test existing source bookmarks, portal views and document reference fields before any custom build. s1 removes 6 of 30 units of repeated navigation and retains 24 for reading and dating the provisions. s3 removes only 1.9 of 19 units of repeated citation/header layout and retains 17.1 for actual property-specific writing and source checking. No common configure reduction is imposed.
The workpaper already supports the appraisal and is read when the value is justified. Same-system save is near-zero, represented by minimum-share s4 at full retention, without a self-gate or saving.

No legal rule or current jurisdictional claim is asserted here. Source validity and applicable national/local rules must be checked on the actual case. Upkeep budgets revised links and citations beyond the retained case reading; no automatic legal interpretation is proposed.
unknowns: Whether the relevant jurisdiction publishes dated searchable material
Actual retrieval time and existing saved views
Which workpaper fields are already filled
research_questions: Trace one property's dated zoning designation and amendments from official sources to the actual valuation workpaper.
Check a nonconforming use and a changed provision without treating an old saved link as current authority.

already_counted.description: Official-source reading, property-specific interpretation, substantive workpaper writing and persistence remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain dated source links and citation fields and repair amended references beyond retained case checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=24+50+17.1+1=92.1. Gross 7.9 minus 2 upkeep gives net 5.9. Conservative case: archive-only provisions and a bespoke exception require 28 of 30 retrieval units and all 19 writing units. The 2 gross units just cover upkeep, while all applicability and valuation work remains retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The appraiser spends less time comparing existing fields and rebuilding market tables, while retaining inspection, comparability choices and the reasons for value.
skills_to_grow: Test property-record joins and source lineage
Distinguish comparable market evidence from mix effects
Keep dated official provisions tied to the actual appraisal
role.ambitious_version: Maintain traceable appraisal evidence whose source differences, market comparisons and physical findings remain visible to the responsible appraiser.

job.title: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate
